request: Snotskull Grunt: Plain and sturdy, not very smart, but can still hurt ya. He holds a frying pan in his right hand; keep held items in the same hand. These are his own signature moves: give him a distinct personality, different from other goblins. Rules from the owner for every goblin: nothing he holds ever goes through his body or the ground; feet stay planted (no sliding or sinking) unless the clip says otherwise; held items stay in the same hand; movements look weighty and cartoony, never floaty. Board games are seen from above and in front, so make poses read clearly from there.

animations.name: OH_Attack
animations.description: Big overhead frying-pan whack: two-handed raise, slam down with a squash on contact ('hit').
